margin_liquidity.numeric_parameters: All member positions, capital, exposures, cash, volatility, rates, thresholds and correlations are hypothetical. No observed loss/default/incident frequencies are generated.
margin_liquidity.market_formula: PnL=effective signed delta*factor move; VM pay=max(-PnL,0), receive=max(PnL,0). Opening requirement=abs(original delta)*unit sigma*risk multiplier. Ending required margin=abs(effective delta)*unit sigma*risk multiplier*volatility multiplier. The positive stock increase is an assumed cash call, separate from VM.
margin_liquidity.market_units: GSD/MBSD factor delta is USD million per bp; NSCC delta is USD million per fractional return. The MBSD factor combines unspecified rate/spread effects without modeling convexity.
margin_liquidity.market_cash_timing: Receipts are available to the same member for a margin call. Potential releases are reported but not immediately recycled. No network timing, settlement failures, inter-member borrowing or production margin model.
margin_liquidity.concentration_formula: Base margin=gross*base fraction; assumed add-on=max(largest security share-threshold,0)*gross*add-on rate. Security HHI is descriptive only. Capital denominator is hypothetical and not a regulatory ratio.
margin_liquidity.sld_formula: Assumed need=max(aggregated affiliated-family exposures). Called deposit=max(need-base resources,0). Allocate call pro rata to exposures in the top N families and their members. Collected cash=min(call,available member cash); uncollected deposits do not cover need.
margin_liquidity.sld_boundary: Toy family allocation, not NSCC Rule 4(A). SLD calls are neither VM cash nor Clearing Fund margin stocks. No actual family membership or calls.
margin_liquidity.cross_margin_formula: max(gross exposure floor, z*sigma*vol*sqrt(a^2+b^2+2*rho*a*b)). This is an illustrative covariance model, not actual GSD/CME eligibility, split or Required Fund Deposit.
margin_liquidity.pairing: Same seed and original member/security inputs across scenarios within each mechanism and replicate. Different business services use separate synthetic portfolios; results do not rank actual business-line risk.
margin_liquidity.interpretation: Stress, mitigation and sensitivity differences follow the declared arithmetic. Monte Carlo spread is assumption-driven path variation, not real-world confidence or causal evidence.
margin_liquidity.catalog_reference: new_reference_chain_tests_2026_10_21/inputs/chain_registry_v3.json; exact existing mechanism definitions, not a new finding about current rules.

default_funding.status: synthetic_only; implementation/scenario exploration, not empirical chain validation
default_funding.units: USD million; relative hypothetical minutes or days; all parameters hypothetical
default_funding.default: Actual default activation is a chosen scenario input, not a calibrated event probability; the two-layer pro-rata allocation is an illustrative accounting mechanism, not official GSD loss allocation.
default_funding.cns: Adverse price = opening price times 1 minus signed position direction times daily_move*sqrt(delay). Every long falls and every short rises in this deliberately adverse scenario. No historical return or probability model is estimated.
default_funding.gcf: Each toy allocation unit requires both cash and collateral; this is a transaction-level joint gate rather than a claim every real GCF member owes both legs. Baseline collateral haircut zero. Mitigation injects explicit cash and collateral and restores earlier availability. No fee estimates.
default_funding.auction: All generated issue obligations assumed already eligible and netted. Shock moves obligations to one date; higher sensitivity also increases volume by 50%. Unpaid obligations carry forward; funds are not unlimited. Added mitigation cash is explicit.
default_funding.banks: Signed participant balances aggregated within service-specific bank IDs. Late acknowledgement/refusal blocks both represented debit and credit balances; net debit is separately reported. Partial payments, reassignment, multilaterally combined DTC/NSCC settlement and production contingency rules are absent. Mitigation assumes timely restored acknowledgement.
default_funding.paired_design: Each model/replicate has identical underlying workload across its six scenarios. Scenarios perturb declared activation, resources, scheduling, delay or acknowledgement; bank workloads differ between services.
default_funding.reference: Exact chain semantics from supplied chain_registry_v3.json expanded_v3 catalog; numeric formulas are declared assumptions, not copied DTCC rules.
default_funding.limits: No synthetic row is a historical event or quarter. No real loss probability, calibrated risk score, causal relationship or business-line risk ranking is established.

service_operations.source_basis: Supplied expanded_v3 chain registry; mechanism labels only, not calibrated operating rules.
service_operations.all_numeric_parameters: Hypothetical; relative simulation minutes are not actual service cutoffs or required completion periods.
service_operations.workload_randomness: Paired generated workload draws, not frequencies of broker failures, outages or restrictions.
service_operations.cash_scope: Only Fund/SERV redemption cash is explicitly conserved. Other instruction notionals are not cash obligations or losses.
service_operations.queue_scope: FIFO by explicit gate eligibility; one synthetic worker per lane, no production optimization, real netting or network spillovers.
service_operations.censoring: Completed-late and unfinished-at-horizon are separate. Delay for unfinished items is a lower bound.
service_operations.exposure_scope: Dependency/acronym/security mappings are generated fixtures, not identified real participants or services.
service_operations.no_causality_claim: No historical validation, calibrated probability, real risk score, p-value or evidence that any actual event reached a service.
service_operations.mitigation_scope: MMI acknowledgement/registration repairs restore missing prerequisites; extra processing capacity and redemption cash are hypothetical additional resources, not free real improvements.
